name: replies
description: Spoken replies for Claude Code: every longer reply becomes a short audio clip on a local web page, with question cards, a chat view, and text or voice responses typed back into the chat. Phone access over your own tailnet.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The Claude model that turns each reply into a short spoken script. It runs once per longer reply on your own Claude account.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port for the page. The phone listener uses the port below it.

phone.title: Phone link
phone.description: on: set up a tailnet-only HTTPS link with `tailscale serve` when Tailscale is signed in. off: local page only.

install_deps.title: Install helpers
install_deps.description: off (default): /replies-setup walks you through installing helpers. on: install ffmpeg, whisper-cpp and tmux with Homebrew and fetch the Whisper model automatically in the background on first run.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where replies and audio are kept. Empty: the plugin's own folder. Set it to reuse an existing reply store.

require_key.title: Require key
require_key.description: on: every request needs this install's private key (links carry it as #k=). off: anything on this Mac can open the page; only for single-user Macs with tools that can't send the key.

footer_badge.title: Footer message
footer_badge.description: on: print "reply-audio latest" after each spoken reply, for a status-line play link.
